description: Returns every release cycle of a product, newest first, with release date, LTS flag, end of active support, end of security support (end of life), status on the given date, days remaining or overdue, and the latest patch version.

date.description: Date to evaluate support on, as YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today. Use it for "will this still be supported on ...?" questions.

product.description: Product id or common name, for example "dotnet", ".NET", "nodejs", "angularjs", "postgres".

name: get_cycles
title: Get release cycles
